title: LOG-01 Stores and logistics
summary: Cost centre LOG-01 covers Stores and logistics in unit NBC-MAN-01 under owner CSHAW, with £505,168.13 available in Q4 budget.
body:
Cost centre LOG-01 covers Stores and logistics operations at Northbridge Cycles within unit NBC-MAN-01 under owner CSHAW [^r1]. As of 26 October 2026 09:00, it remains OPEN in the master register [^r1]. For 2026-Q4, it has an allocated budget of £660,000, with £505,168.13 remaining available against committed spend of £154,831.87 [^r2].

## Cost centre details

LOG-01 is assigned to business unit NBC-MAN-01 and operates under the management of owner CSHAW [^r1]. Its master status is listed as OPEN [^r1].

## Budget and spend

The financial position for 2026-Q4, recorded as of 26 October 2026 09:00, is set out below [^r2]:

| Measure | Amount |
|---|---|
| Total budget | £660,000 [^r2] |
| Committed spend | £154,831.87 [^r2] |
| Available budget | £505,168.13 [^r2] |

Master record definitions and full quarterly budget extracts across all centres are maintained in [[data-cost-centres-and-budgets|Cost Centres and Budgets FY2026-27]] [^r1][^r2].
